page.overview:
Who is Big Daddy of Blooper-surfing?

The Big Daddy of Blooper-surfing or Big Daddy for short (also known as Big Daddy Blooper-surfer, Blooper-surfing Big Daddy, or simply Bloopy) is a character in Super Mario Sunshine.

He is a tan-colored Pianta who wears a straw hat and a light-green shirt.

He is the very friendly owner of the green, pink, and yellow Blooper Racers in Ricco Harbor, allowing Mario to ride them for free, although he "waives all liability for accidents," as crashing a Blooper instantly makes Mario lose a life.

The Big Daddy of Blooper-surfing appears in two episodes of Ricco Harbor, both of which involve Mario riding a Blooper Racer. He first appears in Episode 2: Blooper Surfing Safari, where Mario has to ride on a Blooper Racer during a timed race. If Mario clears the race fast enough, the Big Daddy of Blooper-surfing gives him a Shine Sprite. If Mario does not, he loses an extra life from failing to meet the object. Next, in Episode 6: Red Coins on the Water, the Big Daddy of Blooper-surfing leases Mario a Blooper Racer for free, as Mario is required to ride one to collect all of the Red Coins within the time limit.
